correctness.rationale: Every subspace has unique projection/intersection/graph coordinates. The full tensor square U⊗U has rank u², and the two-sided ideal compulsory space V⊗U+U⊗V has rank 2ru-u². Gaussian counts and q-power graph maps give exactly the polynomials. A uniform Gaussian bound controls all u≥2 subalgebras and u≥1 ideals, while q-Pascal gives the dominant u=1 contribution. Exhaustive independent RREF-subspace checks verify all coefficients for r=1,2 over prime fields q=2,3. All fields and ranks are covered by the proof, not by the finite checks.

value.rationale: The full dimension and projected-rank distributions give natural, previously unlocated subalgebra and ideal invariants for all finite fields and all generator counts, including nongraded subalgebras. The fixed-field limit exhibits a structural separation: almost all subalgebras have one nonzero degree-one direction while almost all ideals are square-contained, with an exact exponential leading constant in the probability of being an ideal. This is motivated by class-two subalgebra/ideal growth, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
